snippet.description:
1999TOKOYO Building
Steam Store Page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4099810

"1999TOKOYO Building" is a visual novel & adventure game where you deepen relationships with peculiar employees and aim to escape from a crumbling indoor amusement park.
